caseName: Laboratory Corp. of America Holdings v. Metabolite Laboratories, Inc.
caseNameFull: Laboratory Corporation of America Holdings, dba LabCorp v. Metabolite Laboratories, Inc.

opinions.text: C. A. Fed. Cir. [Certiorari granted, ante, p. 999.] Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as ami-cus curiae and for divided argument granted. The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.
